book.title: APOSOLO Aposolo Akali Tupamane Piape Peaini Tupa

content: Polo Bala Masetonia, Gitiki-la Potopinjia Okone-lapona Peane Oko

Epesasa tano okona tane tupamane pii taimane loto, kili kalae lo ateaini okone lokoyo piyu, andaka peai-kola, Poloto Kitisene wandakali tupa epo amunguli peakale leaipia. Amunguli peai-kola, balato utupane minu tai laya wato, pii minditupa utupane lamai-yaepia. Lamaiyu, balato yakama atalapape lalu, Masetonia potopinjia okona peaipia.
Bala Masetonia potopinjia okona yuu waka-waka yane tupana epoko pua atoto, Kitisene wandakali tupa minu tai laya wato, pii kambua lamaima pulu, matili bala Gitiki kanditi okona peaipia.

Gitiki kanditi okona ana tepo atalu, matili bala sipinga pitiyu, Sitiya potopinjia okona pokale nembo teane tekeko, balato ale ya-kola, Juta yame wandakali minditupa-mane bala atu sipinga pitiyu, bala peyo ome lamakale lo pii lo puta piyai lene oko ale yaepia. Ale wato, balana nembo-tene oko lawa puato, Masetonia potopinjia okona asini peke lokale nembo teaipia.

Polo bala Masetonia potopinjia okona peke lea-angi, Timotipi, Betiya tano okona tane akali Pitusa iwanane Sopata lene okopi, Tesalonaika tano okona tane lapo akali Atitakusa, Sekundusa-la, okone-lapopi, Depi tano okona tane Gayasa lene okopi, Esia potopinjia tane lapo akali Tikikasa, Topimasa-la, okone-lapopi, utupane bala towa atu peainipia.
Polo bala akali utupane towa atu Pilipai tano okona peakaiyu leai-angi, utupane Totasa tano okona wamba ingane poto, nanima ipulupale lo maliyo ateainipia.

Nanima Pilipai tano okona atema-kola, betesanga yisa napalene nalamane gii oko epea. Gii okone epo koyo pea-kola, nanima sipi mindina pitiyu, Totasa tano poyale pema. Ole yau pea-kola, nanima Totasa tano okona peakaiyu lalu, akali nanima maliyo ateaini utupane malanda alu, nanima pitaka ole yanasa tano okonena atema.
Iwana Yutikasa Omea-kola, Poloto Bala Mina Ika Laya Yane Oko

Sande angi, nanima Totasa tano okona tane Kitisene tupa towa tomo namakale lo amunguli pema-kola, Poloto utupane pii lamaiya. Bala anate-lene pokale nembo toto, pii lamawua teke atea-kola, utulu tombe gulea.
Anda lumu kenga nanima amunguli pua petemane okona lamu kambua kaya-pene ya.

Poloto pii kambua lea-kola, iwana Yutikasa lene mindimane balana pii oko alewa petea. Bala anda lumu kenga wete nanima pii alewa petemane okona windowa mindina pituto, limu mo loto, matili limu pali ondo wato, windowa kamaka aiya pelea. Aiya pelea-kola, wandakali minditupa-mane kili loto, bala molo peai-kola, bala wamba manda tene yaepia.

Manda tene ya-kola, Polo bala anda lumu kenga wete ateane okonena atoto, yuunga kili loto, iwana manda tene yane okonena tokonga paluto, bala minea. Minalu, balato wandakali tupa lamawuato, iwana oko saka ateya-ko. Yakamato anu pimape lo yuku-mane omolaini lea.

Wuane lea-kola, wandakali utupane-mane iwana okone bala lene tala ya lo andoto, yamapane epene wete paluto, balana yame tupamane iwana okone atu andaka peai. Peai-kola, Polo bala wandakali waka tupa towa atu anda lumu kenga okona peke lalu, utupane towa tomo nalu, utupane towa pii lalawa pua peteai. Matili, waa lea-kola, bala pea.
Totasa Tano Tepa Alu, Mailitasa Tano Okona Peaini Oko

Polo bala angu asini poto, Asosa tano okona peakaiyu lokale nembo toto, nanima andayo, yakama sipinga pitiyu, wamba ini ingane pulupape lea. Wuane lea-kola, nanimato bala lamolo makale nembo toto, sipinga pitiyu, Asosa tano okonena wamba ingane poto, bala asini epeakale lo maliyo atema.
Maliyo Atema-kola, bala Asosa tano okona peakaiyu loto, nanima malanda ya. Nanimato bala lamialu, sipinga pitiyu, Mitilini tano okona atu pema.

Pulu, nanima sipinga pitiyu, Mitilini tano tepa alu poto, anate-lene nanima yuu ailene Kayosa okona mandaka gulo pema. Pema-kola, Poloto wamba ini kapoyale Jutusaleme poto, Pendokosa oto oko ando mokale nembo toto, Esia potopinjia okona ole kambua ata napukale nembo teaipia. Wuane nembo tea-kola, anate-lene nanima sipinga pitiyu, Kayosa yuu oko tepa alu pema-angi, nanima Epesasa tano okona puu napene kondalu, Samosa tano okona pema. Pulu, anate-lene nanima sipinga pitiyu poto, Mailitasa tano okona peakaiyu lema.
Poloto Epesasa Tane Akali Esamane Tupa Mana Lamaiyane Oko
Nanima Mailitasa tano okonena peakaiyu lema-angi, Poloto Epesasa tane sosa okona akali esamane tupa bala andolo epeakale loto, akali mindimane utupane lamaulu peakale lea.

Akali utupane epeai-kola, Poloto utupane lamawuato, wamba bulupane tewa namba Esia potopinjia okona epewa-angi, yakamato nambana mana andeai leaipia. Namba Epesasa tano okona atewa-angi, ole dindi lo yakamato nambana mana andeai teke.

Okone angi, Juta yame-mane namba minu koyoyale pii lo puta puato, kenda-pene kambua namba geaini tekeko, namba akali gene nayene koo gulo atoto, Akali Andane okona piape oko ayawa teke pua atewa. Wuane pua atoto, ole kambuanga nambato yakama ondo wato, ai lewa.

Nambato yakamana amunguli piyaini ama tupanapi, yakamana anda tupanapi, utupanena epoto, Gotena pii oko yakama langu atewa. Wuane pua atoto, nambato Juta yame okopi, wandakali yame waka tupapi, yakama pitaka languato, yakamato Gote lo nembo toto, mini peke loto, mana koo yame tupa pitaka masia mawuato, nanimana Akali Andane Jisasa lo bilipi lalapape lewa. Nambato yakama moyolane pii epene okonepene tupana mindikipi mindi wamo napene, pitaka yakama langu atewa. Yakamato nambana mana utupane pitaka nembo teyai okoni.

Wamba namba tano kambua tupana epo paliki pua atauwa-kola, Oli Sipitisa okomane tano utupane pitakana atoto, namba langiki puato, nimba Jutusaleme pole-angi, wandakali-mane nimba andi lolai-kola, kenda-pene kambua nimbanga epolopeya lo namba langiki peane nembo teyo. Oli Sipitisa okomane wuane angu lo namba langiki peya-kola, namba Jutusaleme peakaiyu lolowa-angi, wandakali tupamane anu pulai-kola, kenda-pene utupane nambanga epolo-peyape lo nambato wayumane nembo nateyo tekeko, andipa Oli Sipitisa okomane namba languato, nimba konda naene, Jutusaleme puu lo langipia-kola, namba Jutusaleme poyale peyo.

Kenda-pene utupane nambanga epolopeya tekeko, wamba Akali Andane Jisasa Kataisato namba languato, Goteto wandakali ondo wato moyalane loto, nimbato balana pii layene epene oko wandakali tupa lamawua atape leane. Balato wuane loto, piape okone namba gea-kola, nambato piape okone pikoyo pukale. Piape okone pua atoto, namba omewando, okone katu lolopeya nembo teyo.

Wamba namba yakama tombenenga epoko pua atoto, Goteto nanima ando atalane loto, nambato balana pii layene epene oko yakama langu atewa. Langu atoto, nambato Gotena pii layene minditupa wamo napene, Goteto wua lo nembo talane lo balana pii tupa pitaka yakama langu atewa. Langu atewa-kola teke, yakamana mindimane Gotena pii utupane ale naene, alu peaindo, yakama alu pulaini okonena tene oko nambanga nayolopeya loto, andipa nambato yakama enene langeyo. Andipa namba yakama tepa alu polowa-kola, yakamana mindikipi mindimane namba dee lapone anda napulu-peyai nembo teyo.

Goteto balana sosa oko balana iwanane okona tundupa okomane kambo meane okonena, yakama Kitisene wandakali tupa balana sipisipi gulo ateyai. Namba yakama tepa alu polowa-angi, wandakali minditupa peango anatope koo gulo atoto, Gotena sipisipi yame tupa tombenenga epoto, utupane minu koyolo-peyai nembo teyo. Wandakali koo utupane-mane wuane pulaini loto, wamba Oli Sipitisa okomane yakama balana sipisipi yatawa atalaini akali tupa gulo atalapale lo yapa lo meane. Balato piape okone yakama geane okonena, yakamato yakama tane tika ando atoto, Gotena sipisipi tupa pailo ando atalapape.
Matili yakamana Kitisene akali minditupa-mane wandakali tupa kilau lo moyale, Gotena pii oko mo lawa puato, pii minditupa utupane lamalu-peyai.

Yakamato akali utupane wato minulaini nembo toto, wamba nambato ai loto, yakama mindiki-mindiki lo languato, wandakali mindimane wuane pulane. Waiwa ando atalapape laka pua atewa. Wuane pua atoto, mali tepo utulu otongapi, namba kepa naene, yakama pitaka mindiki-mindiki lo Gotena pii langu atea lo yakamato nembo tatawa atalapape. Yakamato wuane lo nembo tatawa atoto, wandakali mindimane Kitisene wandakali minditupa kilau lo mo awua puyangi lolane. Waiwa ando atalapape.

Gotena pii layene epene okomane pii mindi loto, matili balato balana wandakali ateakale lata ene tupa pitaka ondowa moyoto, paluni epene minditupa utupane maiyane layene eya. Wuane pua teke, balato yakama minu tai laya wato, paluni epene minditupa yakama geakale nembo toto, andipa nambato yakama balana kininga tepa eyo.
Wamba namba yakama towa atu atoto, wandakali yangone mindikipi mindina muni yandopi, tona yandopi, okonetaka mindi miauwa lakae lo nembo natewa. Jia.

Nambapi, wandakali namba towa atu atemane tupapi, nanimanga minditaka jia yo atema-angi, namba tanena kini-mane piape puato, nambato minditaka jia yane tupa miaka pua atewa lo yakamato nembo teyai okoni.

Wamba Akali Andane Jisasato pii mindi leane oko loto, wandakali mindimane minditaka mindi mialu atoto, epele ape-pene tekeko, wandakali mindimane minditaka mindi wandakali waka mindi maiyu atoto, epele wete ape-pene leaipia. Yakamato Jisasana pii okone nembo toto, wandakali tai nalene tupa moyo piape piyapale lo yakama andawa lokale nembo tewa. Nambato wuane nembo toto, namba tanena kini-mane piape puato, nambato minditaka jia yene wandakali tupa moyo, minditaka maiki pewa leaipia.
Poloto pii utupane lokoyo piyu, akali esamane tupa towa aiki leka wato, pote lea.

Pote lokoyo pea-kola, utupane-mane Polona pii nembo tolo-peke leai. Wamba balato yakamana mindikipi mindimane namba dee lapone anda napulu-peyai leane nembo tolo-peke loto, utupane pitaka-mane bala epelewa bulu ope loto, ai andane kambua leai. Wuane piyu, utupane-mane bala sikane lalu, bala ape yolo, sipi yane ongane atu peai.
